candidate.title: scNMT-seq
candidate.scope: The central scNMT-seq (single-cell nucleosome, methylation and transcription sequencing) row of the assigned Illumina schematic, interpreted as the Clark et al. 2018 implementation. One isolated cell supplies a bead-bound poly(A) RNA route to a transcriptome library and a GpC-labelled genomic DNA route to scBS-seq, with endogenous CpG methylation and chromatin accessibility read from the latter. Smart-seq2 and scBS-seq are embedded components. The partial scTrio-Seq2 row and its upper scBS-seq expansion, and the lower scCOOL-seq/NOMe-Seq/PBAT row, are neighboring context, not alternative targets of this card.
